# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About Thai Hair Go
Thai Hair Go is a unique medical tourism company that combines professional hair transplant procedures in Thailand with a luxurious vacation experience. The brand bridges the gap between medical treatment and travel, offering clients the opportunity to undergo hair restoration while enjoying the beauty and hospitality of Thailand. The concept is built on the dual promise of transformation — both physical (renewed hair) and experiential (an unforgettable trip).

## Target Audience
- אנשים הסובלים מנשירת שיער המעוניינים בהשתלת שיער בחו"ל תוך שילוב חופשה

## Industry
רפואה אסתטית / תיירות רפואית
